races.speed.title.note: Title of the speed chart of all laps.

races.speed.reading.text: Reading the speed of all laps…

races.laps.pit-in.note: Note of a lap that ends in the pit lane. Lower case.

races.laps.pit-out.note: Note of a lap that starts in the pit lane. Lower case.

races.laps.lap.note: Column title of the lap table: the lap number.

races.laps.time.note: Column title of the lap table: the lap time.

races.laps.gap.note: Column title of the lap table: the difference to the best lap.

races.laps.position.note: Column title of the lap table: the position at the start and at the end of the lap.

races.laps.top-speed.note: Column title of the lap table: the highest speed of the lap.

races.laps.off-track.note: Column title of the lap table: the moments off the track.

races.laps.hint-reference.text: Select a lap to compare it with lap {lap}, the best lap without a pit stop.

races.legend.off-all.text: all four wheels off the track
races.legend.off-all.note: Legend of the red sign of a moment off the track. Lower case.

races.legend.off-part.note: Legend of the yellow sign of a moment off the track. Lower case.

races.cursor.lap.note: Line under the title of the position chart. {lap} is the lap at the cursor, {position} the position there.

races.cursor.lap-up.text: Cursor at lap {lap}: position {position}, up from {from}.
races.cursor.lap-up.note: Line under the title of the position chart when the position becomes better at the cursor. {from} is the position before.

races.cursor.lap-down.text: Cursor at lap {lap}: position {position}, down from {from}.
races.cursor.lap-down.note: Line under the title of the position chart when the position becomes worse at the cursor. {from} is the position before.

races.cursor.place.note: Line under the title of the position chart. {lap} is the lap at the cursor, {place} the distance from the lap line, {position} the position there.

races.cursor.place-up.text: Cursor at lap {lap}, {place}: position {position}, up from {from}.
races.cursor.place-up.note: Line under the title of the position chart when the position becomes better at the cursor. {place} is the distance from the lap line, {from} the position before.

races.cursor.place-down.text: Cursor at lap {lap}, {place}: position {position}, down from {from}.
races.cursor.place-down.note: Line under the title of the position chart when the position becomes worse at the cursor. {place} is the distance from the lap line, {from} the position before.

races.box.lap.note: First line of the box at the cursor of the position and fuel charts. {lap} is the lap number.

races.box.lap-place.note: First line of the box at the cursor of the position and fuel charts. {lap} is the lap number, {place} the distance from the lap line.

races.box.position.note: Line of the box at the cursor of the position chart. {position} is the position.

races.box.change.note: Line of the box at the cursor of the position chart when the position changes there. {from} is the position before, {position} the position after.

races.box.fuel.note: Line of the box at the cursor of the fuel chart. {fuel} is the fuel in percent.

races.box.no-fuel.note: Line of the box at the cursor of the fuel chart when there is no fuel value.

races.compare.no-match.text: These two laps do not match. Choose another lap.
races.compare.no-match.note: Compare tab when GT7 Tutor cannot match the two laps.

races.compare.one-lap.text: This race has one lap. There is no other lap to compare.
races.compare.one-lap.note: Compare tab when the race has only one lap.

races.compare.option.note: Item of the lap lists on the Compare tab. {lap} is the lap number, {time} the lap time.

races.compare.off-line.text: Up to {size} from the line of lap {lap}
races.compare.off-line.note: Difference of the side distance on the Compare tab. {size} is the distance with its unit, {lap} the lap to compare with.

races.compare.pit-in-out.text: The curve starts at the pit exit. The rest of the gap is in the pit lane.
races.compare.pit-in-out.note: Note under the time chart when one lap goes into the pit lane and one lap comes out of it.

races.compare.pit-in.text: The rest of the gap is in the pit lane.
races.compare.pit-in.note: Note under the time chart when a lap goes into the pit lane.

races.compare.both-out.text: This lap and lap {lap} start in the pit lane. The curve starts at the pit exit.
races.compare.both-out.note: Note under the time chart when both laps start in the pit lane. {lap} is the lap to compare with.

races.compare.this-out.text: This lap starts in the pit lane. The curve starts at the pit exit.
races.compare.this-out.note: Note under the time chart when the selected lap starts in the pit lane.

races.compare.other-out.text: Lap {lap} starts in the pit lane. The curve starts at the pit exit.
races.compare.other-out.note: Note under the time chart when the lap to compare with starts in the pit lane. {lap} is that lap.

races.compare.lap-name.note: Name of a lap in the chart readouts and in the heading of the Compare tab. {lap} is the lap number. Lower case.

races.compare.best-legend.note: Legend of the line of the lap to compare with when it is the best lap. {lap} is the lap number. Lower case.

races.compare.time-label.note: Accessible name of the time chart. {lap} is the lap to compare with.

races.compare.speed.note: Title of the speed chart on the Compare tab.

races.compare.kph.note: Unit of the speed chart on the Compare tab.

races.compare.throttle.note: Title of the throttle chart on the Compare tab.

races.compare.brake.note: Title of the brake chart on the Compare tab.

races.compare.time.note: Title of the time chart on the Compare tab. {lap} is the lap to compare with.

races.compare.seconds.note: Unit of the time chart on the Compare tab.

races.compare.map.text: Map of the line of lap {with} and the line of lap {lap}
races.compare.map.note: Title and accessible name of the map on the Compare tab. {with} is the lap to compare with, {lap} the selected lap.

races.compare.map-pit.text: A gap in the line is the pit lane.
races.compare.map-pit.note: Note under the map on the Compare tab when a lap goes through the pit lane.

races.compare.side-label.text: The side distance of lap {lap} is drawn {factor} times larger.
races.compare.side-label.note: Line under the map on the Compare tab. {lap} is the selected lap, {factor} the scale factor.

races.compare.dialog-label.text: Line of lap {with} and line of lap {lap} of {race}
races.compare.dialog-label.note: Accessible name of the full-screen map on the Compare tab. {with} is the lap to compare with, {lap} the selected lap, {race} the race name.

races.compare.dialog-line.note: Legend of the line in the full-screen map on the Compare tab. {with} is the lap to compare with.

races.compare.hint.text: Focus a chart and use the arrow keys to move the cursor. The map point shows the same place.
races.compare.hint.note: Keyboard help of the charts, for a screen reader only. It is not shown on the screen.

races.compare.intro.text: Lap {lap} is one of your laps, not the best possible line.
races.compare.intro.note: Note under the title of the differences on the Compare tab. {lap} is the lap to compare with.

races.compare.none.text: No differences above the limits between these two laps.
races.compare.none.note: Compare tab when the two laps have no difference.

races.compare.no-difference.note: Text of a turn with no difference on the Compare tab.

races.compare.whole.note: Badge of the differences outside every turn on the Compare tab.

races.compare.same.text: Lap {lap} has the same time as {with}.
races.compare.same.note: Heading of the Compare tab when the two laps have the same time. {lap} is the selected lap number. {with} is the lap name from races.compare.lap-name and does not wrap.

races.compare.gap.note: Heading of the Compare tab. {lap} is the selected lap number. {gap} is the coloured time from races.compare.slower or races.compare.faster. {with} is the lap name from races.compare.lap-name and does not wrap.

races.compare.slower.note: Coloured part of the heading of the Compare tab when the selected lap is slower. {seconds} is the time with three decimals.

races.compare.faster.note: Coloured part of the heading of the Compare tab when the selected lap is faster. {seconds} is the time with three decimals.

races.compare.lap.note: Hidden label of the list of the selected lap.

races.compare.with.note: Hidden label of the list of the lap to compare with.

races.compare.comparing.note: Compare tab while the comparison loads.

races.off.no-line.text: The laps of this race give no line of the track, so the places cannot be drawn.
races.off.no-line.note: Off the track tab when the laps give no line of the track.

races.off.strip-label.text: Off the track, lap by lap, over the distance from the lap line
races.off.strip-label.note: Accessible name of the off-track strip.

races.off.places-title.note: Title of the list of the recurring places.

races.off.places-text.text: The same place in 3 or more laps.
races.off.places-text.note: Line under the title of the recurring places.

races.off.places-none.text: No place in 3 or more laps.
races.off.places-none.note: Recurring places when no place is in 3 or more laps.

races.off.place-all_one.text: All four wheels off in {count} lap.
races.off.place-all_one.note: Fact of a recurring place. {count} is the number of laps with all four wheels off.

races.off.place-all_other.text: All four wheels off in {count} laps.
races.off.place-all_other.note: Fact of a recurring place. {count} is the number of laps with all four wheels off.

races.off.place-part.note: Fact of a recurring place when no lap had all four wheels off.

races.off.place-count.note: Number of laps with the recurring place. {laps} is that number, {total} the number of laps.

races.off.other-places_one.text: {count} other place, each in 1 or 2 laps.

races.off.other-places_other.text: {count} other places, each in 1 or 2 laps.
races.off.other-places_other.note: Line under the recurring places. {count} is the number of other places off the track.

races.off.moments-label.note: Accessible name of the list of the moments off the track by lap.

races.off.lap.note: Title of the moments of one lap. {lap} is the lap number.

races.off.moment.note: Moment off the track with no place. {wheels} is the wheel text, {speeds} the speeds. GT7 Tutor writes the first letter as a capital letter.

races.off.moment-at.note: Moment off the track. {place} is the distance from the lap line, {wheels} the wheel text, {speeds} the speeds.

races.off.box-title.note: Title of the box of the selected moment. {lap} is the lap number, {place} the distance from the lap line.

races.off.place-mark.note: Accessible name of the mark of a recurring place on the map. {label} is the letter of the place.

races.off.item.note: Moment in the list of the full-screen map and in the line under the charts. {lap} is the lap number, {wheels} the wheel text, {speeds} the speeds.

races.off.speed-best.note: Title of the speed chart on the Off the track tab when the reference is the best lap.

races.off.speed-lap.note: Title of the speed chart on the Off the track tab. {lap} is the reference lap.

races.off.kph.note: Unit of the speed chart on the Off the track tab.

races.off.places.note: Title of the map on the Off the track tab.

races.off.legend-all.text: all four wheels off the track
races.off.legend-all.note: Map legend of the red mark. Lower case.

races.off.legend-part.note: Map legend of the yellow mark. Lower case.

races.off.legend-place.note: Map legend of the mark of a recurring place. Lower case.

races.off.map-best_one.text: Map of the line of the best lap with {count} moment off the track
races.off.map-best_one.note: Accessible name of the map on the Off the track tab when the reference is the best lap. {count} is the number of moments.

races.off.map-best_other.text: Map of the line of the best lap with {count} moments off the track
races.off.map-best_other.note: Accessible name of the map on the Off the track tab when the reference is the best lap. {count} is the number of moments.

races.off.map-lap_one.text: Map of the line of lap {lap} with {count} moment off the track
races.off.map-lap_one.note: Accessible name of the map on the Off the track tab. {lap} is the reference lap, {count} the number of moments.

races.off.map-lap_other.text: Map of the line of lap {lap} with {count} moments off the track
races.off.map-lap_other.note: Accessible name of the map on the Off the track tab. {lap} is the reference lap, {count} the number of moments.

races.off.list-title.note: Title of the list in the full-screen map.

races.off.dialog-best.text: Line of the best lap of {race} with the moments off the track
races.off.dialog-best.note: Accessible name of the full-screen map when the reference is the best lap. {race} is the race name.

races.off.dialog-lap.text: Line of lap {lap} of {race} with the moments off the track
races.off.dialog-lap.note: Accessible name of the full-screen map. {lap} is the reference lap, {race} the race name.

races.off.line-best.note: Legend of the line in the full-screen map when the reference is the best lap.

races.off.line-lap.note: Legend of the line in the full-screen map. {lap} is the reference lap.

races.off.strip-unit.note: Unit of the rows of the off-track strip. Lower case.

races.off.height-label.note: Accessible name of the height chart.

races.off.height-readout.note: Readout of the height chart at the cursor. {metres} is the height above the lowest place of the lap.

races.off.speed-label-best.text: Speed of the best lap, km/h
races.off.speed-label-best.note: Accessible name of the speed chart on the Off the track tab when the reference is the best lap.

races.off.speed-label-lap.note: Accessible name of the speed chart on the Off the track tab. {lap} is the reference lap.

races.off.speed-readout.note: Readout of the speed chart at the cursor. {lap} is the reference lap, {speed} the speed without a unit. Lower case.

races.off.chart-pit.note: Chart legend of the pit lane band. Lower case.

races.off.chart-place.note: Chart legend of the band of a recurring place. Lower case.

races.off.cursor.note: Line under the charts on the Off the track tab. {place} is the cursor distance, {length} the lap length, both with the unit.

races.off.cursor-facts.note: Line under the charts on a phone when the player selects a moment. {facts} is that moment.

races.off.none.text: No moments off the track in this race.

races.off.reading.text: Reading the places off the track…
races.off.reading.note: Off the track tab while the places load.

races.golden.reading.note: Golden lap tab while the data loads.

races.golden.band.note: Hidden name of the dark band with the best lap, the golden lap and the possible gain.

races.golden.clean-range.note: Part of the facts line in the band. {first} and {last} are the first and the last clean lap. A clean lap is not lap 1 and has no pit stop. Lower case.

races.golden.clean-list_one.note: Part of the facts line in the band. {laps} is the list of the clean laps. Lower case.

races.golden.clean-list_other.note: Part of the facts line in the band. {laps} is the list of the clean laps. Lower case.

races.golden.best-lap.note: Caption under the best clean lap time in the band of the golden lap. A clean lap is not lap 1 and has no pit stop. {lap} is the lap number. Lower case.

races.golden.golden-from_one.note: Caption under the golden lap time. {laps} is the list of the laps that give the parts. Lower case.

races.golden.golden-from_other.note: Caption under the golden lap time. {laps} is the list of the laps that give the parts. Lower case.

races.golden.golden.note: Caption under the golden lap time on a phone. Lower case.

races.golden.gain.note: Caption under the time that the golden lap gains on the best lap. Lower case.

races.golden.method-short_one.text: From lap {laps}. At each join the speed differs by {speed} km/h at most and the line by {side} m at most.
races.golden.method-short_one.note: Text under the band on a phone. {laps} is the list of the laps that give the parts. {speed} and {side} are the largest differences at a join.

races.golden.method-short_other.text: From laps {laps}. At each join the speed differs by {speed} km/h at most and the line by {side} m at most.
races.golden.method-short_other.note: Text under the band on a phone. {laps} is the list of the laps that give the parts. {speed} and {side} are the largest differences at a join.

races.golden.turns.note: Title of the table of the turns. Also the name of the table.

races.golden.column-turn.note: Column header button. It puts the turns in the order of the track.

races.golden.column-part.note: Column header: the distance range of the turn on the lap.

races.golden.column-golden.note: Column header: the time of the turn in the golden lap and its source lap.

races.golden.column-best.note: Column header: the best time of the turn and its lap.

races.golden.column-median.note: Column header: the median time of the turn over the clean laps.

races.golden.column-spread.note: Column header button. It puts the turn with the largest spread first. The spread is the median time minus the best time.

races.golden.column-spread-short.note: Column header button on a phone. It puts the turn with the largest spread first.

races.golden.part.note: Distance range of a turn in metres. {from} and {to} are the distances from the lap line.

races.golden.lap.note: Source lap of a time in the table. {lap} is the lap number. Lower case.

races.golden.left_other.note: Note under a time of the golden lap. These laps left the track in this turn, so their times do not count here. {laps} is the list of the lap numbers.

races.golden.map-title.note: Title of the map of the golden lap.

races.golden.map-label.text: Map of the golden lap: each part in the colour of its source lap
races.golden.map-label.note: Hidden name of the map of the golden lap.

races.golden.legend-lap.note: Legend of the map: the colour of the parts from this lap. Lower case.

races.golden.legend-join.note: Legend of the map: the circle where two parts join. Lower case.

races.golden.few_other.text: A golden lap needs {min} clean laps. This race has {count}: laps {laps}.
races.golden.few_other.note: Reason for no golden lap. {min} is the smallest count of clean laps. {count} is the count of clean laps. {laps} is the list of the clean laps.

races.golden.few-none.text: A golden lap needs {min} clean laps. This race has no clean lap.
races.golden.few-none.note: Reason for no golden lap when the race has no clean lap. {min} is the smallest count of clean laps.

races.golden.not-first.text: Lap {lap} is the first lap of the race and does not count.
races.golden.not-first.note: Why a lap is not clean. {lap} is the lap number.

races.golden.not-first-recorded.text: Lap {lap} is the first recorded lap and does not count.

races.golden.not-pit_one.text: Lap {laps} has a pit stop and does not count.

races.golden.not-pit_other.text: Laps {laps} have a pit stop and do not count.
races.golden.not-pit_other.note: Why laps are not clean. {laps} is the list of the laps.

races.golden.not-open_other.text: Laps {laps} have no time for each part of the lap and do not count.

races.stage.recorded-time.note: Race stage: caption under the sum of the recorded lap times. Lower case.

races.stage.position.note: Race stage: the position of the car. {position} is the number.

races.stage.of-cars.note: Race stage: caption under the position. {cars} is the number of cars. Lower case.

races.stage.position-caption.note: Race stage: caption under the position when the number of cars is not known. Lower case.

races.stage.recording.note: Race stage: status at the top while the race recording runs.

races.stage.recording-no-telemetry.note: Race stage: status at the top while the race recording runs and no packet arrives.

races.stage.telemetry.note: Race stage: status at the top when packets arrive and no recording runs.

races.stage.no-telemetry.note: Race stage: status at the top when no packet arrives and no recording runs.

races.stage.waiting.note: Race stage: the large word while the recording waits for a race. It cannot wrap.

races.stage.finished.note: Race stage: the large word after the finish. It cannot wrap.

races.stage.finished-position.note: Race stage: the large finish position after the finish when the number of cars is not known. {position} is the number. It cannot wrap.

races.stage.stopped.note: Race stage: the large word after the player stopped the recording.

races.stage.lap.note: Race stage: the large word during a lap. {lap} is the lap number. {of} is the small text from races.stage.word-of. It cannot wrap.

races.stage.joined.note: Race stage: the line above the lap word after the recording joined a race that already runs.

races.stage.unsupported.text: This is not a race of 2 or more laps. Only a race by laps can be recorded.
races.stage.unsupported.note: Race stage while the game runs a race that is not by laps.

races.stage.start.text: Start a race of 2 or more laps in the game.
races.stage.start.note: Race stage while the recording waits for a race.

races.stage.waiting-note.text: The recording starts with the race and stops at the finish. You can look at the TV now.
races.stage.waiting-note.note: Race stage: the second line while the recording waits for a race.

races.stage.joined-note.text: The recording starts at the next lap line.
races.stage.joined-note.note: Race stage line after the recording joined a race that already runs.

races.stage.finished-start.note: Race stage line after the finish. {position} is the start position.

races.stage.finished-saved.text: The race is in your list.
races.stage.finished-saved.note: Race stage line after the finish when the race is in the list.

races.stage.finished-start-saved.text: You started in position {position}. The race is in your list.
races.stage.finished-start-saved.note: Race stage line after the finish when the race is in the list. {position} is the start position.

races.stage.not-stored.text: The race could not be stored. Its raw capture stays on this computer.
races.stage.not-stored.note: Race stage line after the player stopped the recording and the race cannot be stored.

races.stage.no-lap.text: No complete lap was recorded. Nothing was saved.
races.stage.no-lap.note: Race stage line after the player stopped the recording before the end of a lap.

races.stage.stopped-saved_one.text: {done} of {count} lap is in your list. The race is marked as not finished.
races.stage.stopped-saved_one.note: Race stage line after the player stopped the recording. {done} is the number of recorded laps, {count} the number of laps of the race. The plural form follows {count}, because the noun comes after it.

races.stage.stopped-saved_other.text: {done} of {count} laps are in your list. The race is marked as not finished.
races.stage.stopped-saved_other.note: Race stage line after the player stopped the recording. {done} is the number of recorded laps, {count} the number of laps of the race. The plural form follows {count}, because the noun comes after it.

races.stage.race-recording.note: Race stage: line at the top under the status when the car name is not known.

races.stage.cancel.note: Race stage button while the recording waits for a race. It stops the recording.

races.stage.close.note: Race stage button after the end of the recording. It closes the stage.

races.stage.stop.note: Race stage button that stops the race recording.

races.stage.open.note: Race stage button that opens the stored race.

races.stage.opens.text: It opens by itself in a moment.
races.stage.opens.note: Race stage line next to the button that opens the race after the finish.

races.stage.back.note: Race stage button that opens Races when the race was not stored.

races.trail.text: The line of the last lap, brightest at the car
races.trail.note: Accessible name of the line drawing on the race stage.

races.off.place-detail.note: Detail of a recurring place. {loss} is the largest speed loss.

races.off.place-detail-best.text: Best lap: {speed} km/h here. Largest speed loss: {loss} km/h.
races.off.place-detail-best.note: Detail of a recurring place when the reference is the best lap. {speed} is the speed of the best lap there, {loss} the largest speed loss.

races.off.place-detail-lap.text: Lap {lap}: {speed} km/h here. Largest speed loss: {loss} km/h.
races.off.place-detail-lap.note: Detail of a recurring place. {lap} is the reference lap, {speed} its speed there, {loss} the largest speed loss.

races.stage.finished-position-of.note: Race stage: the large finish position after the finish. {position} is the number. {of} is the small text from races.stage.word-of. It cannot wrap.

races.stage.word-of.note: Race stage: the small text after the lap number or after the finish position. {total} is the number of laps or of cars. Lower case.

charts.off-track.row.note: Accessible name of one lap row of the off-track strip. {lap} is the lap number.

charts.race.lap-axis.note: Name of the lap axis under the position and fuel charts. Lower case.

exercises.add.source.note: One catalogue source in the list of sources. {name} is the source name, {licence} its licence.

exercises.delete.references-active_one.note: Item of the delete list when the exercise has an active reference. {references} is the bold number of references from common.count.reference.

exercises.delete.references-active_other.note: Item of the delete list when the exercise has an active reference. {references} is the bold number of references from common.count.reference.

exercises.review.reference-used.note: Item of the reference list of the review: the reference that the attempt used. {name} is the reference name.

exercises.review.lede-complete.note: Text under the review title of a complete attempt. {date} is the start date and time.

exercises.review.lede-complete-gap.text: {date}. Times from the game. Gap to the compared reference.
exercises.review.lede-complete-gap.note: Text under the review title of a complete attempt with a time difference to the reference. {date} is the start date and time.

exercises.review.lede-not-finished.note: Text under the review title of an aborted attempt without a known reason. {date} is the start date and time.

exercises.review.lede-not-finished-reaso.note: Text under the review title of an aborted attempt. {date} is the start date and time, {reason} the reason.

setup.console.receiving-undecoded.note: Result of the reception check when some packets cannot be decoded. {receiving} is the text from setup.console.receiving, {undecoded} the text from setup.console.undecoded.

exercises.compare.callout-spoken.note: Accessible name of a dot on the map at the largest side distance in a turn. {turn} is the turn badge, {metres} the distance, {side} left or right, {place} the distance from the start.

exercises.compare.map-label-side.note: Accessible name of the map with the larger side scale. {map} is the map name, {side} the sentence about the scale.
